==Transportation==
* [[Minigame Teleport]] to Fishing Trawler, requiring 15 [[Fishing]]
* The [[Khazard Teleport]] on the [[Lunar spellbook]] or [[Khazard teleport (tablet)|tablet]]
* The [[Charter ship]] destination of [[Port Khazard]]
* The [[Ardougne cloak]] teleport to the [[Ardougne Monastery]], then run south-east
* [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|DJP}}, then run south
* The [[Watchtower Teleport|Watchtower]] or [[Ardougne Teleport|Ardougne]] teleport or [[Watchtower teleport (tablet)|tablet]]
* Spirit tree teleport to Tree Gnome Village, follow Elkoy out of the maze, run East then South
